answers.text: "Pivot clear did not hold into the close": weak close is real on D and H1, so I move from act-now to wait-for-hold. Weekly still HH/HL with 9>21 and D 1.04% above swing high; rs_rank_pct is my proxy for criterion 8. Template holds; entry waits.

"buys a breakout at the extreme": agreed on chase, so I wait for volume. But D swing HH but LL is not my test; weekly above EMA9, 9>21, HH/HL, 7.4% above swing high is the template. H1 at the high is strength, not weakness.
